primary_trigger.action: Add inference instances when sustained traffic approaches the safe operating capacity

scale_out.goal: Keep traffic per instance below the measured safe capacity

scale_in.action: Reduce replicas during sustained low traffic
scale_in.protection: Do not scale below the minimum production replica count

batching.reason: Online recommendation requests require low-latency responses

precomputation.future_use: Can be introduced for repeated or cacheable recommendation requests
